T: Eastbound and down. Pass the ribs.
D: A bootlegger runs a truckload of beer across state lines with a sheriff chasing him the whole way.
P: Serve the mains when the Bandit picks up Frog by the side of the road.
S: the truckers' stops on the CB radio
Pork rind scored, salted and dried in the fridge overnight, roasted at 240C for 30 minutes until puffed and crackling, broken up and dusted with smoked paprika and cayenne.
Raw peanuts in the shell boiled 2 hours in heavily salted water with a little Cajun spice, left to soak an hour, served warm in paper cups.
a Texas sheriff a long way from home
Okra packed into jars with garlic, dill and chilli, covered in hot vinegar brine, pickled a week, served cold with sharp cheddar.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar, garlic and cayenne, smoked or baked wrapped at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with a tangy vinegar barbecue sauce under the grill. Coleslaw.
a quick stop while the Snowman keeps rolling
Minute steaks pounded thin, dredged in seasoned flour, buttermilk and flour again, fried until crisp, smothered in cracked pepper cream gravy. Mash.
W: Sliced peaches with brown sugar, cinnamon and lemon, covered in buttery biscuit dough, baked at 190C for 40 minutes. Vanilla ice cream.
K: Light American lager ice cold from an esky, or a sweet iced tea for the drivers.

s.how: Simmer 500g raw peanuts in the shell for 2 hours in water with 80g salt and 1 tbsp Cajun seasoning. Turn off the heat and soak an hour. Drain and serve warm in paper cups.

s.note: a Texas sheriff a long way from home
s.how: Pack 400g okra into a jar with 3 garlic cloves, dill and a chilli. Pour over 300ml hot white vinegar boiled with 200ml water and 1 tbsp salt. Pickle a week. Serve cold with 200g sharp cheddar.

m.note: a quick stop while the Snowman keeps rolling
m.how: Pound 4 minute steaks thin. Dredge in seasoned flour, then buttermilk, then flour again and fry until crisp. Whisk 2 tbsp flour into the pan fat, add 400ml milk and lots of cracked pepper and simmer. Serve over mash.

w.how: Toss 6 sliced peaches with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and lemon juice. Rub 80g butter into 200g self-raising flour, add 150ml milk and drop over the fruit. Bake at 190C for 40 minutes. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Bury eight 355ml bottles of light American lager in an esky of ice for an hour. Brew 4 black tea bags in 1L water, sweeten and chill over ice for anyone doing the Atlanta run in 28 hours.
